newsitem.title: USA: TMP Worldwide to offer 4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: TMP Worldwide to offer 4 mln shares.

text.p: TMP Worldwide said Monday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 4.0 million shares.
Of the 4.0 million shares, 2.4 million are new shares and are part of a follow-on offering to the company's initial public offering in December 1996 at $14 per share.
The remaining 1.6 million shares are being offered for sale by TMP stockholders, including 1.2 million from company Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Andrew McKelvey.
McKelvey and certain other sellers will repay to the company about $12 million in loans, clearing up outstanding debts.

Proceeds from the sale of shares by the company, as well as from loan repayment by certain sellers, will be used to repay debt resulting from TMP's acquisition program, including debt to be incurred in connection with the proposed acquisition of Austin Knight, a large global recruitment advertising network headquartered in the UK.
Terms of the Austin Knight transaction were not immediately available.
As a result of the the acquisition, TMP will add 29.3 million stg in commissions and fees on 1996 gross billings of 134.4 million stg.
After the stock offering, TMP will have 25,984,882 shares outstanding, with 13,587,541 Class B Shares held by McKelvey (91.6 percent of the combined voting power of the company).
Morgan Stanley Dean Witter is the lead manager of the offering. Goldman, Sachs & Co, BT Securities Corp, Montgomery Securities and Ladenburg Thalmann & Co Inc are co-managers.
